Which keyword stops fall-through in switch?
score = 55: if(score>=75) A else if(score>=50) B else C. Result?
Explain why == should not be used to compare Strings.
bank.model: == compares object addresses, so two Strings with the same text may be different objects; equals() compares the characters.

bank.q: When would you use switch instead of if/else?
bank.model: When one value is compared against several exact constants (days, menu choices); if/else is better for ranges.
